scientific_scope: Exact offline minimum-edit dynamic programming for at most k edits at positions below M with the last pair strictly protected, including M=1. It does not automatically handle exactly k edits.
Selected J,C,D and protected row: O(M^4) transitions, O(M^3) rolling states and final readout evaluations. Full first/second-segment histograms: O(M^9) transitions and O(M^8) rolling states.
Exact utility evaluation/comparison, readout encoding, integer/bit costs, indexing and witness reconstruction are additional. The loose polynomial upper bounds are not practical-efficiency claims.
Minimum-cost dominance uses only the state interface; arbitrary whole-word or general Transformer readouts are outside scope unless the state is expanded and its bounds reproved.

Substitution into the prior empirical objective is exact only for the same eligible count-bank/endpoint predictor, same conditional estimate and exact comparison. The DP does not learn or estimate the predictor or p(h).
No new generic DP novelty, learned robustness, SGD convergence, unknown-budget adaptation or worst-source statistical guarantee is claimed.

The two real correction edges preserve first the exact-estimator substitution and then the necessary predictor-class restriction. Earlier candidate headers are retained; later independent LLM review binds the exact final note.

finite_checks.histogram_range: M=1 through 6, all histories and every budget 0 through M
finite_checks.limitations: Finite evidence supports but does not replace the general proof. The author selected-bank brute force shares bank-update code; the separate independent recount checks its semantics.

publisher_public_replay.local_scope: Exact public-only stage and direct dependencies; no full historical research replay or new training.

review_identity: Source-bound independent LLM audit, not external peer review, formal proof or novelty certification.
earlier_material: No existing manuscript, training archive, source map, historical failure or workflow is modified.
